'''Jik Shashoul''' was a notable [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'' was held aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], a rumor circulated around the ship that Shashoul had traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
